Method of Attack: Exploitation of symlinks in the sandbox directory to write to arbitrary files and gain code execution outside the sandbox.

Method of Attack: Bypassing a patch for CVE-2024-28185 by using the UNIX chown command on an untrusted file within the sandbox.
Attack Vector: Creation of a symbolic link to a file outside the sandbox

Method of Attack: Exploitation of SSRF vulnerability to escape the sandbox and gain unsandboxed code execution as root.
